qa_pair.question: In the library-search fixture, discover the Workshop library and search for Workshop. Which origin label accompanies Workshop.pdf, without following the linked private directory?
In the network-places fixture, list saved sources and inspect the valid NAS source. What URL remains after the invalid embedded-password entry is excluded?
In the shared-notes fixture, search Workshop, then read Workshop and follow its available links. Which linked note can be read while Private remains excluded?
In the shared-notes fixture, compare memory context outside the project with context inside it. What fact appears only in the project scope?
In the task fixture, list visible tasks using two pages of size two and omit the dismissed completed task. How many distinct tasks remain?
In the task fixture, find Task 1 and inspect its events and status. What proposal detail is recorded, without approving or running the task?
In the settings fixture after the preference update, inspect Files settings and compare the saved search delay with the original 250. What value is now saved?
In the enabled Inbox fixture, search Workshop, page the results and read one matching message using all identifiers. What is its body, excluding raw MIME?
In the Inbox fixture, inspect the cached Workshop calendar result and its cache flag. Does the tool synchronize the calendar during this call?
In the Vault fixture, inspect the Backup plan timestamp and its verification flag. What last-backup timestamp is cached, despite the repository being unreachable?
